reason: The patch adds Javadoc describing what each Clients scope grants (MANAGE, VIEW, CONFIGURE, MAP_ROLES, MAP_ROLES_COMPOSITE, MAP_ROLES_CLIENT_SCOPE) at services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionEvaluator.java:43-188, so documentation for the scopes is added. It is true that no docs/*.adoc file is touched and the constants at server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:55-68 carry no Javadoc, but the existing V2 Users resource type has no user guide either.
